Hi Karthik,

Following up from this morning's call — ClearGate needs a short handoff packet from Redwood's on-call team so our SOC can close the escalation and complete the SIG/CAIQ mapping. Specifically we need:

- A copy of the incident runbook version the on-call used (redacted where needed)
- Access logs for the window: 2026-11-01T00:00 to 2026-11-01T08:00 PST (S3/edge only)
- A short post-incident note confirming the IR plan you used and the primary escalation contacts

We're prepared to receive artifacts via SFTP (temporary account) or a shared Drive link. Can your team confirm the delivery method and a 2-hour window for transfer tomorrow (Mon)?

Also: to satisfy our compliance team, can you confirm Redwood formally acknowledges the IR plan used during the event and whether any retained telemetry will include PII beyond hashed ids?

Thanks — small ask, need to close our SIG review by Tue EOD.

Alan Ross

Adding specifics from Security:

- Redaction rules: remove full IP addresses (keep /24 prefix), strip any user-agent strings with device identifiers, replace usernames with consistent hashed ids, and null any email address strings. We'll include a redaction manifest for traceability.
- Minimal artifact set (to keep within CLA): the S3 access logs (edge access only), the runbook excerpt (pages 2-4), telemetry snippet (first 10k lines, redacted).
- Retention exception: we'll grant a temporary retention exception allowing ClearGate to hold artifacts for 30 days for audit; we need a signed acceptance of our business terms.

Alan — does ClearGate need any extra attestations (SOC 2 mapping statement, or a short CAIQ crosswalk)? We can include a 1-page CAIQ excerpt but full questionnaires are handled via our compliance portal.
